title: Quantum Security of Group-Adapted Even-Mansour and Three-Round Feistel
summary: The source presents quantum-secure pseudorandom-permutation security for the adapted constructions as a conjecture, so proving it remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Prove that the adaptations of Even--Mansour and three-round Feistel to suitable group families are qPRPs.

scope.domain: Quantum-secure symmetric-key cryptography for group-adapted block-cipher constructions.
parameters: suitable group families: families to which the constructions are adapted
scope.unresolved_remainder: A proof that the adaptations of Even--Mansour and three-round Feistel to suitable group families are qPRPs.

citations.label: Quantum-Secure Symmetric-Key Cryptography Based on Hidden Shifts

progress.summary: The source explicitly conjectures that adaptations of the constructions to other group families are qPRPs. The open task is to prove this conjectured security property.
citation_labels: Gorjan Alagic et al., Quantum-Secure Symmetric-Key Cryptography Based on Hidden Shifts
